headline: Mozzarina Milk Maker
title: Mozzarina | Milk For Your Kitchen | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want milk without hunting for it? Bring Mozzarina to the Ranch. Its partner skill, Milk Maker, sometimes drops Milk while it is assigned there, and Milk is a handy cooking ingredient. It is a Neutral Pal whose base work is Farming. It is a calm, cow-like Pal that is easy to keep at base for a steady supply. Do you run a milk ranch? Comment below!
description: Mozzarina in Palworld 1.0: Milk Maker drops Milk at the Ranch, and Farming is its base work.
